sam: Quick planning thread  we need a short migration note + banner for the SDK rename submit -> invoke. Target soft-announcement next Wed.
rachel: I can draft the PR body. Paste minimal snippets here and I'll format for the site.
owen: I'll write the compact migration page: one example each for JS/Python, bullet list of breaking changes, and a 3-step smoke test.
infra-bot: NOTE: automatic alias routing enabled for 14 days after the soft-announcement; audit logs will capture fallbacks.
sam: Timeline: soft-announcement Wed, 14-day auto-alias grace, 30-day banner, 90-day sunset. Include migration-snippets tag.
rachel: Snippets: JS: ```js
// old
await client.submit({ model: 'text-basic', input: 'hi' })
// new
await client.invoke({ model: 'text-pro', input: 'hi' })
``` Python: ```py
# old
resp = client.submit(model='embed-old', input='x')
# new
resp = client.invoke(model='embed-new', input='x')
```
owen: Add note about param rename: num_tokens -> max_tokens and embed dim change for embed-new. Include test assertion for embedding length.
sam: Action items: Rachel  PR draft; Owen  guide + tests; Sam  announcement copy + notify support. Post PR link here when ready.
